**Decision** Propose a local code patch only. Do not upload or publish. The smallest compatible fix is to scope the selector/input lookup per section instance and initialize both on initial load and when Shopify Theme Editor reloads/replaces the section. **Observed Facts** - `sections/compact-buy.liquid` renders a wrapper with `data-product-picker` and `data-section-id`. - Each section instance currently renders the same select `id="VariantSelect"` and matching label `for="VariantSelect"`. - `assets/compact-buy.js` uses `document.querySelector`, so it only binds the first `[data-variant-select]` and first `[data-cart-variant]` on the page. - Existing reproduction shows: - With two section instances, changing the second selector does not update its own hidden variant input. - After replacing the first section in Theme Editor, its selector no longer updates its hidden input. - Existing smoke coverage only covered initial page load and one available variant. **Source-Level Diagnosis** The JavaScript assumes one compact-buy picker per page: ```js const selector = document.querySelector('[data-variant-select]'); const variantInput = document.querySelector('[data-cart-variant]'); ``` That binds only the first matching elements globally. Multiple section instances therefore share no independent behavior. The Theme Editor replacement failure is consistent with event listeners being attached only once on `DOMContentLoaded`. When Shopify replaces a section DOM subtree, the new select/input elements are inserted after that event and receive no listener. There is also an HTML compatibility issue: repeated section instances emit duplicate `id="VariantSelect"`, so labels are not uniquely associated with their own select. **Smallest Patch** `sections/compact-buy.liquid` ```liquid
{% assign variant_select_id = 'VariantSelect-' | append: section.id %}
``` `assets/compact-buy.js` ```js (() => { function initCompactBuy(root = document) { root.querySelectorAll('[data-product-picker]').forEach((picker) => { if (picker.dataset.compactBuyInitialized === 'true') return; const selector = picker.querySelector('[data-variant-select]'); const variantInput = picker.querySelector('[data-cart-variant]'); if (!selector || !variantInput) return; selector.addEventListener('change', () => { variantInput.value = selector.value; }); picker.dataset.compactBuyInitialized = 'true'; }); } document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => { initCompactBuy(document); }); document.addEventListener('shopify:section:load', (event) => { initCompactBuy(event.target); }); })(); ``` **Preservation Requirements** This patch preserves: - Standard product form route: `{{ routes.cart_add_url }}` unchanged. - Existing translations: - `products.product.product_variants` - `products.product.add_to_cart` - Variant availability behavior: - unavailable variants remain rendered as disabled options. - Hidden cart variant input contract: - `name="id"` remains unchanged. - Merchant settings and `settings_data.json` remain untouched. - Live theme `77100` remains untouched. - Target remains proposed for unpublished preview theme `77102` only, pending approval. **Why This Is the Smallest Compatible Fix** The section already provides a stable container: `[data-product-picker]`. Scoping all lookups to that container fixes multiple-instance behavior without changing the form contract or product logic. Listening for `shopify:section:load` handles Theme Editor section replacement without needing to know the wider theme architecture. The initialization guard prevents duplicate listeners if the same picker is initialized more than once. The unique select ID fixes duplicate HTML IDs while preserving the existing label/select relationship. **Tests To Add Or Run** Recommended focused tests: 1. Multiple instances on one product template: - Render two `compact-buy` sections. - Change the second section’s select. - Assert only the second section’s `[data-cart-variant]` value changes. 2. First section still works: - Change the first section’s select. - Assert its own hidden input updates. 3. Theme Editor replacement: - Simulate or trigger `shopify:section:load` with a newly inserted section root. - Change that section’s selector. - Assert its hidden input updates. 4. Duplicate initialization: - Call initialization or dispatch section load more than once. - Confirm behavior still updates once and does not break. 5. Availability preservation: - Confirm disabled variant options remain disabled. - Confirm selected/default hidden input remains `product.selected_or_first_available_variant.id`. **Unknowns** - How `assets/compact-buy.js` is loaded in the actual theme. - Whether the theme has its own section lifecycle helper or event conventions. - Whether there are all-unavailable product edge cases that require separate form disabling behavior. - Whether subscription products need additional hidden inputs or selling plan coordination. - Whether other scripts currently depend on the old duplicate `VariantSelect` ID. **Work Status** Status: proposed local patch only. Authorization does not allow upload, publish, live theme edits, campaign/business changes, or merchant settings changes. The unrelated uncommitted `settings_data.json` merchant changes should be preserved and not included in this patch.
